The UPSC Result 2025 has been officially declared by the Union Public Service Commission. In the UPSC CSE Final Result 2025, Anuj Agnihotri has secured All India Rank 1, while Rajeshwari Suve M secured Rank 2 and Akansh Dhull secured Rank 3, emerging as the top performers in this year’s Civil Services Examination.
Following the declaration of the UPSC Final Result 2025, the Union Public Service Commission officially released the UPSC Markssheet 2025 PDF.

The release of the UPSC Marksheet 2025 PDF of recommended candidates completes the final stage of the Civil Services Examination cycle. While the merit list confirms the rank and recommendation status of candidates, the marksheet provides a comprehensive breakdown of performance in the Mains Examination and the Personality Test (Interview).

2. How many candidates were selected in the UPSC Result 2025? A total of 958 candidates were recommended for appointment in the UPSC Result 2025, as mentioned in the official merit list released by UPSC.
3. Who secured Rank 1 in the UPSC Result 2025? Anuj Agnihotri secured AIR 1 in the UPSC Result 2025, topping the Civil Services Examination 2025.
4. Where can I download the UPSC Result 2025 PDF? Candidates can download the UPSC Result 2025 PDF from the official website upsc.gov.in under the “Final Result” section.
7. When will UPSC release marks after the UPSC Result 2025? The detailed marks of candidates are usually released separately by UPSC a few days after the UPSC Result 2025 declaration.
8. Who secured Rank 2 in the UPSC Result 2025? Rajeshwari Suve M secured Rank 2 in the UPSC Result 2025, emerging as one of the top performers in the Civil Services Examination.
9. Who secured Rank 3 in the UPSC Result 2025? Akansh Dhull secured Rank 3 in the UPSC Result 2025, placing among the top three candidates in the final merit list.
10. What happens after the UPSC Result 2025 is declared? After the UPSC Result 2025, recommended candidates move to the service allocation stage based on rank, category, and service preferences.
